proposal: Local weighted 2-means within each original parent, shared assignment learned from all76fit trajectory features; fixed original parent assignment; no global reclustering.
cost: Squared position distance plus squared covariance Frobenius distance, averaged across time. Source-opacity-normalized mixture weights; not physical mass or Gaussian W2.

rankings.window: Minimum mean CTD decrease across 5 equal-duration fit-time windows
rankings.first: CTD decrease at first fit time only; shares the same76time-fitted child partition
rankings.random: Uniform eligible parent sampling without replacement using the resolved per-condition seed

gain: Exact local weighted SSE decrease (m0*m1/(m0+m1))*squared_distance(child_centers), with original parent fixed
appearance: Inherit E04 joint42 shared parent SH; split optical depth by child mixture-weight fractions. Coincident-footprint transmittance preserved, actual different child footprints need not preserve rendered appearance. All arms fine-tune shared SH+opacity equally.
control: Within each condition split arms have equal base_budget+splits Gaussians. Unsplit control K10000 gets the same1520additionalupdates. Budget comparison only at seed42.
evaluation: No holdout/test selection. Report fit/holdout CTD, teacher fidelity,20GT PSNR/SSIM/standardLPIPS,256pxfixed-camera temporal residual, before and after final fixed-step optimization.
limitations: Offline splitting existing reduced clusters, not training-time adaptive densification
CTD gain is guaranteed algebraically for a fixed split; rendering improvement is not
All scores share fit76 child partitions; first-frame arm isolates ranking, not a full independent per-frame algorithm
No explicit velocity loss or physical mass claim
seed_scope: Appearance view order and random parent sampling only; baseline, CTD parent grouping, fit76 shared child partitions and E04 initialization remain fixed.
reuse: Reuse complete original splits256 seed42; no selecting conditions or checkpoints on evaluation.
limits: Three order/random-selection seeds at budget256; budget128/512 each seed42 only. Not full-pipeline multi-seed validation.
